title: Characterization of VPS13Cs Binding to GUVs
author: xinbo.wang
materials: Buffer (500 mM sucrose, 25 mM HEPES, pH 7.4)
Initiate polymerization by adding 10 μL APS and 1 μL TEMED TEMED Bio-Rad Laboratories Catalog #1610801 .
Acquire images using the spinning-disk super-resolution microscope.

steps.title: Sonicate and APTES‑treat coverslips
steps.instruction: Sonicate coverslips sequentially in distilled water then ethanol; incubate them in 10 % APTES in ethanol for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash, dry, and heat coverslips
steps.instruction: Remove the coverslips, wash thoroughly with water, then dry them at 50 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Prepare polyacrylamide gel solution
steps.instruction: Mix 250 µL acrylamide, 10 µL bis‑acrylamide (Sigma‑Aldrich Cat #M1533), and 729 µL H₂O; degas the mixture under vacuum for 30 min.

steps.title: Cast gel on coverslips and polymerize
steps.instruction: Place 30 µL of the PAA gel solution on a clean glass plate, lay the treated coverslip on top, and allow polymerization for 15 min.

steps.title: Wash, dry, and store gel‑coated coverslips
steps.instruction: Wash the gel‑coated coverslips with distilled water, dry them, and store at 4 °C until further use.

steps.title: Glutaraldehyde fixation of coverslips
steps.instruction: Wash coverslips with ethanol followed by distilled water, then incubate them in 2.5 % glutaraldehyde solution (Sigma‑Aldrich Cat #G6257, CAS 111‑30‑8) prepared in PBS for 30 min.

steps.title: Add sucrose‑HEPES buffer and incubate overnight
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of buffer containing 500 mM sucrose and 25 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, to the gel‑coated coverslips and incubate overnight to allow GUV formation.

steps.title: Prepare lipid mixtures in chloroform
steps.instruction: Dissolve lipids in chloroform at 1 mg/mL. For POPC‑GUVs use 89.5 % POPC (Avanti #850457), 10 % DOPS (Avanti #840035), and 0.5 % Rhod‑PE (Avanti #810150) or Cy5‑DOPE (Avanti #810335). For DOG‑GUVs use 59.5 % POPC, 10 % DOPS, 30 % DOG (Avanti #800811C), and 0.5 % Rhod‑PE or Cy5‑DOPE.

steps.title: Apply lipid solution and evaporate solvent
steps.instruction: Place the gel‑coated coverslips into 6‑well plates, add 20 µL of the appropriate lipid solution onto each gel, spread evenly, and evaporate the solvent under vacuum for 40 min.

steps.title: Harvest GUVs into tubes
steps.instruction: Gently pipette the formed GUVs and transfer them into clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Add GUVs to BSA‑passivated dish
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of the collected GUV suspension to a BSA‑passivated 35 mm glass‑bottom MatTek dish.

steps.title: Incubate GUVs with protein or lysate
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL of purified protein (final concentration 300 nM) or cell lysate to the dish and incubate for 10 min at room temperature.
